description.value: The odor of the incense within your censer smells overwhelmingly foul to your enemies. Any enemy within your smoke cloud who retches in an attempt to recover from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Sickened] condition must roll the save twice and take the worse result; this is a misfortune effect. In addition, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Swing the Censer]'s frequency becomes once per round, and any creature who fails its saving throw against your censer's adept benefit is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Slowed]{Slowed 1} for as long as it its sickened.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
